name: astryon
description: ASTRYON — monitoramento local das antenas Starlink + ESP32 (projeto independente, sem afiliação com a Starlink/SpaceX).

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint:agent
scripts.lint:agent: node scripts/venv.mjs ruff check astryon_agent tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck:agent
scripts.test: npm run test:agent && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w supabase
